title: Restaurant: reservations
job: Book a table or plan a visit
why: An imminent visit calls for practical information. Destination dining can give more room to its story while keeping the main action clear.
avoid: Do not create food product cards when online ordering is unavailable.

title: Restaurant: delivery
alternative_a: Find a location or delivery service
why: Focus on assortment, price, ingredients, and delivery area.
avoid: Do not hide allergens, delivery time, or availability.

title: Grocery: physical stores only
why: A product showcase can operate without online sales; the action can offer directions or a shopping list.
avoid: Do not add checkout when the store cannot fulfill online orders.

title: Grocery: delivery
why: Users need to confirm service area and availability.
avoid: Do not promise prices or stock without regional data.

title: Real estate: no catalog
why: A qualified inquiry and trust are the main goals; invented listings do not support them.
avoid: Do not show empty filters or present sold properties as available.

title: Real estate: catalog
why: Comparison by price, floor area, and address depends on a current inventory.
avoid: Do not promise availability without synchronized data and an update date.

title: Travel: advisor-led
why: The service sells itinerary-planning expertise rather than a fixed package.
avoid: Do not publish invented departure dates or final prices.

title: Travel: ready-made tours
why: The tours are standardized enough to compare.
avoid: Do not present an example itinerary as a guaranteed available product.

title: B2B: catalog with prices on request
why: The product can be standardized while its commercial quotation is tailored.
avoid: Do not use a cart when online pricing is unavailable.

title: B2B: company website and catalog
alternative_a: Homepage: capabilities with Catalog and Partnership entry points
why: Company information and the assortment serve different tasks but can share branding and navigation.
avoid: Do not create two isolated websites without links or consistent company information.

title: eSIM: consumer plans
alternative_a: Packages by data allowance and duration
why: Geography and plan parameters determine the choice.
avoid: Do not hide fair-use policy, activation conditions, or device requirements.

title: eSIM: business service
alternative_a: Request a demo or make contact
why: The client is choosing a process and supplier responsibility rather than a single country.
avoid: Do not make a consumer storefront the only journey for a business buyer.
